editorNote: Today's edition centers on a fresh flashpoint between Washington and Beijing over AI model distillation, alongside a run of watchlist moves driven by the same hot inflation print: bitcoin and gold both retreated ahead of today's CPI report. Elsewhere, Google's Gemini Enterprise platform found its way into industrial welding robots, Berkshire Hathaway's filings revealed a quietly built Alphabet stake, and Duolingo and Rocket Lab posted incremental, unspectacular updates. A guilty plea in one of the largest bitcoin thefts on record rounds out a day that was more about positioning than fireworks.

stories.headline: US agencies name Alibaba in a joint advisory on AI-model distillation
stories.summary: The NSA, CISA and FBI issued a joint advisory on September 8 accusing six China-based AI developers -- Alibaba, DeepSeek, Moonshot AI, MiniMax, StepFun and Z.AI -- of running industrial-scale distillation campaigns against US frontier models including Claude, GPT, Gemini and Grok, extracting billions of tokens via gray-market API proxies. Alibaba's US-listed shares fell about 0.4% to $108.93 the next day as investors weighed the fallout.
stories.whyItMatters: A formal multi-agency advisory raises the odds of tighter access controls or compliance costs that could complicate Alibaba's push to make Qwen a global AI platform.

sourceLinks.title: Alibaba Drops as Washington Turns AI Distillation Into Geopolitical Risk

stories.headline: Bitcoin falls below $77,000 as hot producer prices lift Fed rate-hike odds
stories.summary: Bitcoin dropped nearly 2% to just under $77,000 -- a weekly loss of more than 5% -- after August producer prices rose 5.4% year-over-year, above the 5.1% forecast, pushing 30-year Treasury yields to a 19-year high. Odds of a Fed rate hike next week rose to about 70%, and US spot bitcoin ETFs saw $120 million in outflows.
stories.whyItMatters: The move shows bitcoin trading in step with rate expectations rather than as an inflation hedge, with technical support seen near $76,270.

sourceLinks.title: Bitcoin Below $77,000 as Traders Bet on a Fed Rate Hike

stories.headline: Gold heads for a third straight weekly decline ahead of today's CPI report
stories.summary: Spot gold traded near $4,328 an ounce, up slightly on the day but on track to lose about 2% this week -- its third consecutive weekly decline -- after Thursday's hotter-than-expected August producer-price data lifted Fed rate-hike bets. Markets are awaiting Friday's CPI print, the last major inflation data before next week's Fed meeting.
stories.whyItMatters: Rising rate-hike expectations are capping gold's upside even as geopolitical risk and oil above $100 a barrel keep some safe-haven demand in play.

sourceLinks.title: Gold eyes $4,300 break as USD sticks to gains amid Fed hike bets, ahead of US CPI

stories.headline: Fanuc shares hit a record high on a new Google-powered welding AI
stories.summary: Fanuc and Google unveiled the 'AI Welding Agent,' which reads engineering drawings and auto-generates robotic arc-welding programs using Google Cloud's Gemini Enterprise platform, requiring "zero setup and zero teaching." Fanuc shares jumped as much as 15.6% to an all-time high of ¥8,880; the system will be demoed September 16 and starts shipping by year-end.
stories.whyItMatters: It extends Google's Gemini Enterprise push into industrial robotics -- Fanuc says it has already shipped over 1,000 physical-AI-equipped robots since December.

sourceLinks.title: FANUC Accelerates Physical AI in Arc Welding with the New 'AI Welding Agent'
Japan's Fanuc shares hit record high on Google physical AI partnership

stories.headline: Alphabet cracks Berkshire Hathaway's top five holdings
stories.summary: Berkshire Hathaway added 24.5 million Alphabet shares last quarter, a 45% increase, lifting its stake to roughly 79 million shares worth about $28.2 billion -- its fourth-largest holding at 9.41% of the portfolio. Berkshire only began buying Alphabet a year ago with an initial $4.4 billion purchase; Alphabet shares are down about 7% over the past month on AI-capex concerns.
stories.whyItMatters: It's the first stock to enter Berkshire's top five in years, disclosed via regulatory filing rather than any statement of intent from the company.

sourceLinks.title: Berkshire Hathaway Has a New Top Holding, and It Dominates Its Market

stories.headline: Duolingo shares rebound 4.3% after a two-day slide
stories.summary: Duolingo stock closed up 4.3% at $145.16 on Thursday, recovering part of a prior slide. Second-quarter daily active users rose 23% year-over-year, but bookings -- the metric closer to near-term demand -- grew only 8%, a gap that's central to the debate over the stock's valuation.
stories.whyItMatters: The bookings-versus-engagement gap, not the user-growth headline, is what analysts say will determine whether the current valuation holds up.

sourceLinks.title: Duolingo Stock Rebounds 4.3%--Why 23% User Growth Isn't the Key Number

stories.headline: Rocket Lab completes its 16th Electron launch of the year
stories.summary: Rocket Lab's "Happily Ever Faster" mission lifted off from Launch Complex 1 in New Zealand, deploying a single Earth-observation satellite to a 500km orbit for a confidential customer. It was the company's 95th Electron launch overall and 16th of 2026, with another commercial launch planned before month's end.
stories.whyItMatters: The steady launch cadence underscores Rocket Lab's position as the leading small-launch provider, independent of any single mission's dollar value.

sourceLinks.title: Rocket Lab Successfully Launches 16th Electron Mission Of The Year

stories.headline: Singapore-born hacker pleads guilty in $240 million bitcoin theft
stories.summary: Malone Lam, 22, pleaded guilty Tuesday to a federal racketeering conspiracy charge for orchestrating the theft of over 4,100 bitcoin -- about $245 million at the time -- from a Washington, D.C. resident in August 2024, using social-engineering tactics that impersonated Google and Gemini exchange staff. He faces up to 20 years in prison and is the 11th of 18 charged defendants to plead guilty.
stories.whyItMatters: It's one of the largest cryptocurrency thefts prosecuted in the US and a reminder that custody of crypto assets, not just their price, carries security risk.

sourceLinks.title: Singapore man in U.S. pleads guilty to orchestrating $240 million bitcoin theft
